d.why: On screen only in Daredevil: Born Again 1x02 Optics (mentioned in 1x03 and later), where his subway death at Hector Ayala's hands is the killing Ayala is charged with, so the episode's case is about him.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 1x04 Sic Semper Systema as Matt's client and again in 1x09 Straight to Hell, out on the street.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 1x01, 1x03, 1x06 and 1x07 as the Five Families boss who feuds with Viktor and Fisk.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 1x02 Optics and 1x03 The Hollow of His Hand as Ayala's key witness who lies on the stand.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 1x01 Heaven's Half Hour and 1x03 The Hollow of His Hand in the Five Families toll feud with Luca.

On screen only in Daredevil: Born Again 2x01 The Northern Star (mentioned later); he scuttles the Northern Star with Daredevil aboard and is the man Fisk's Task Force hunts down and kills, so the episode turns on him.

On screen only in Daredevil: Born Again 2x01 (voice only in 2x07, mentioned in 2x03 and 2x08), where as Attorney General he demands oversight of Fisk and folds after one call, an official with a few lines in Fisk's story; he is nobody's family or boss.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 2x05 The Grand Design, operating on Vanessa, and 2x06 Requiem, where Fisk crushes him to death.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 2x01-2x04 and 2x08 (footage only in 2x06), hiding Achilleo, jailed by the Task Force and testifying against Fisk.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 2x02-2x04 and 2x08 (footage only in 2x06), from his bodega arrest to testifying against Fisk.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 2x02, 2x04, 2x06 and 2x08 as Angela's friend who passes on the SD card and joins the protests.

On screen only in the Daredevil: Born Again 2x05 The Grand Design flashback, where he berates the associates over the McCoy case; kept because he is the boss at Landman and Zack of Matt Murdock and Foggy Nelson, who both have files.
On screen in Daredevil: Born Again 2x01, 2x03 and 2x06 as the Lieutenant Governor confronting Fisk.

On screen only in Daredevil: Born Again 2x05 The Grand Design, whose flashback plot is Matt and Foggy's case representing him: he refuses the plea deal, walks on a bad warrant and flees with Foggy's savings.
On screen only in Echo 1x03 Tuklo, helping hold Maya and Bonnie for the cartel bounty; kept because she is the sister of Vickie Tyson, who has a file.
On screen in Eyes of Wakanda 1x02, where he leads the Myrmidons into Troy and dies fighting Memnon, and non-speaking in 1x04 The Last Panther.

Speaking role only in Eyes of Wakanda 1x03 Lost and Found (a non-speaking glimpse in 1x04), scolding Basha and promoting Ebo; kept because as War Dogs High Councilor he is the commanding officer of Basha and Ebo, who have files.

On screen only in Hawkeye 1x01 Never Meet Your Heroes (mentioned later), where he threatens Eleanor, wins Ronin's sword at the auction and is found murdered, the death that drives the plot; he is also Jack Duquesne's uncle, and Jack has a file.
On screen in Hawkeye 1x01 at the gala and 1x06 at the Bishop Christmas party (mentioned in 1x03).
On screen in Hawkeye 1x02, 1x05 and 1x06 as the NYPD detective who arrests Jack and then Eleanor.
On screen in Hawkeye 1x01, 1x02, 1x03 and 1x06 as the Tracksuit Mafia thug from the auction robbery to Rockefeller Center.
On screen in Hawkeye 1x02, 1x04 and 1x06 as the LARP organizer who helps Clint and Kate.
On screen in Hawkeye 1x02, 1x04 and 1x06 as a LARPer in Grills' guild who helps at Eleanor's party.
On screen in Iron Fist 1x04 Eight Diagram Dragon Palm at Colleen's dojo and 1x11 Lead Horse Back to Stable, where she hands Colleen to the Hand.

On screen only in Iron Fist 1x01 Snow Gives Way, a homeless man who helps Danny with a phone, shoes and food and then dies of an overdose: a helper in Danny's story, and nobody with a file is his family or works for him.
On screen in flashbacks in Iron Fist 1x01, 1x02 and 1x11, and she is Danny Rand's mother and Wendell Rand's wife, both of whom have files.

On screen only in Iron Fist 1x04 Eight Diagram Dragon Palm (mentioned in Daredevil 3x06), a Bulletin reporter who questions Danny at a press event and writes him up: a bit part, and she is nobody's family or boss.
On screen in Iron Fist 1x03, 1x10, 1x11 and 1x12 as Harold Meachum's enforcer.
On screen in Iron Fist 1x01, 1x02, 1x09 and 1x10 as Harold Meachum's assistant until Harold kills him.
On screen in Iron Fist 1x04, 1x05, 1x07, 1x08 and 1x10 as the Rand board member Harold murders.
